apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed
- Get all after bringing in several files from Spotify at once (Exportify's CSV files) asked for only the 50 most played albums. It now asks for every missing song, each once, however many playlists it's in, and the count of songs not in the library no longer counts them twice.

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating.
